fusions.name: Drumming Knuckles
fusions.desc: Pounds every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 7 damage to each. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 7 tiles to a target, then deals 16 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Weathered Hide
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% for 30 seconds.

fusions.name: Broad-Backed Mount
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.6 seconds. You can ride it.
